milestone-4-pipeline-freshness::feature-.description: Implement pre-reminder official source freshness verification workflow to validate that opportunities are not withdrawn or 404 before dispatching urgent deadline reminders.
acceptance_criteria: verifyReminderCandidateFreshness(sql, candidate) verifies source freshness within 24h of reminder due time
Detects withdrawn/missing opportunities (HTTP 404/410 or explicit withdrawal state) and suppresses scheduled reminder dispatch
Preserves idempotency and prevents duplicate reminder attempts for verified or suppressed candidates
Retains local-sink isolation; no live external requests without injected/mocked transport in tests
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/reminder-recheck.test.ts && npm run typecheck

milestone-4-pipeline-freshness::feature-.description: Implement shared source-refresh tracking service and UI indicator to record and display when all active enabled sources have completed their collection cycles, surfacing refresh status, completion timestamps, and outstanding overdue counts in the admin operations summary.
acceptance_criteria: trackSourceRefreshCycle(sql) calculates or records completion metrics across all enabled non-synthetic sources
Exposes lastCompleteRefreshAt, totalSources, completedSources, and overdueCount
Admin operations summary at /admin/operations displays the shared refresh status card with bilingual labels
Zero private user data or raw request credentials exposed
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/refresh-tracker.test.ts && npm run typecheck

milestone-4-pipeline-freshness::feature-.description: Implement automated robots.txt access policy parser and validator to evaluate candidate official source URLs against host access rules before collection scheduling.
acceptance_criteria: parseRobotsTxt(content) parses User-agent, Allow, Disallow, and Crawl-delay directives
isUrlAllowed(robotsRules, url, userAgent) correctly determines path allowance with standard wildcard and prefix matching rules
Extracts host crawl-delay in seconds and enforces maximum bounded limits
Handles malformed content, empty files, comments, and missing directives gracefully with safe defaults (allow if not explicitly disallowed)
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/robots-policy.test.ts && npm run typecheck

milestone-5-discovery-pacing-scoring::fe.description: Implement coordinated host-wide collection rate limiter and pacing service to track per-host request intervals, enforce minimum delays derived from host robots crawl-delay or default minimum cadence, and prevent concurrent request bursts against the same university domain.
acceptance_criteria: createHostPacer(options) tracks per-host timestamps and schedules or evaluates next eligible request time
Enforces host-level minimum intervals respecting parsed crawlDelaySeconds and minimum floor
Binds host keys by normalized origin hostname (lowercased, default ports removed)
Provides concurrency limiting per host to prevent parallel fetches against a single origin
Operates in-memory with deterministic clock injection in unit tests
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/host-pacer.test.ts && npm run typecheck

milestone-5-discovery-pacing-scoring::fe.description: Implement deterministic language proficiency score evaluation and qualification matching service for applicant profiles against scholarship requirement criteria, supporting IELTS (0–9), TOEFL iBT (0–120), and Chinese HSK (Levels 1–6) score comparisons.
acceptance_criteria: evaluateLanguageRequirement(profileScores, requirement) deterministically checks applicant eligibility against opportunity language criteria
Supports IELTS band scores (including overall and sub-band minimums), TOEFL iBT total scores, and HSK level + total score rules
Evaluates test score validity window / freshness relative to opportunity deadline
Returns structured match result with boolean eligible, deficit details, and human-readable explanation keys
Handles missing or exempt applicant test scores with safe fallback semantics
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/language-scoring.test.ts && npm run typecheck

milestone-5-discovery-pacing-scoring::fe.description: Implement RSS 2.0 and Atom XML source feed adapter for official admissions and scholarship feed collection, extracting item title, canonical link URL, publication date, GUID/id, and sanitized summary text within bounded payload limits.
acceptance_criteria: parseRssOrAtomFeed(xmlText) parses standard RSS 2.0 and Atom XML feed payloads into structured feed items
Extracts title, link URL, publication date (RFC 822 / ISO 8601), and unique identifier (guid or id)
Safely strips/sanitizes HTML from summary/description and normalizes relative links against optional feed root URL
Enforces maximum payload size and maximum item count limits to prevent memory exhaustion
Handles invalid XML, namespaces, CDATA, and missing fields gracefully with safe fallbacks
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/rss-feed.test.ts && npm run typecheck

milestone-6-extraction-deadlines-anonymi.description: Implement automated candidate link discovery and URL extractor for official university admissions and scholarship directory/listing HTML pages, parsing anchors, resolving relative paths against parent base URL, enforcing same-origin or permitted academic subdomain policies, filtering by scholarship/admission keywords, excluding non-html assets, and deduplicating canonical candidate URLs.
acceptance_criteria: extractCandidateLinks(html, baseUrl, options) extracts candidate opportunity links from HTML anchor tags
Resolves relative URLs to absolute URLs against baseUrl using standard URL normalization
Filters candidate links to same host or academic subdomains while excluding third-party links, social media, and tracking URLs
Applies scholarship and admission heuristics matching terms like scholarship, admissions, international, apply, bursary, fellowship, 奖学金, 招生, 留学生 in URL paths and anchor text
Excludes binary assets, documents, and fragments (e.g., .pdf, .zip, .docx, .png, .jpg, #hash, mailto:, javascript:)
Enforces bounded limits (max candidate count, max HTML length) and canonical URL deduplication
Handles malformed HTML safely without throwing unexpected exceptions
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/candidate-extractor.test.ts && npm run typecheck

milestone-6-extraction-deadlines-anonymi.description: Implement precise deadline semantics, timezone parsing, and rolling admission status evaluation for opportunities, supporting date-only deadlines, precise closing timestamps (with timezone offsets such as China Standard Time UTC+8), rolling admissions, and multiple intake rounds.
acceptance_criteria: parseDeadline(input, options) parses diverse deadline strings and formats into a structured ParsedDeadline object (kind: 'date' | 'timestamp' | 'rolling' | 'rounds' | 'unknown')
For date-only deadlines (YYYY-MM-DD), resolves to end-of-day in China Standard Time (UTC+8 / Asia/Shanghai) by default, or an explicitly supplied timezone
For precise timestamps (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm with timezone like CST, UTC, GMT+8, etc.), resolves exact ISO UTC instant
Recognizes rolling admissions indicators ('rolling', 'until filled', '滚动录取', '额满为止') with isRolling: true
Supports structured multiple intake rounds (e.g. Round 1, Round 2) and identifies the next upcoming round deadline
evaluateDeadlineStatus(parsed, now) returns boolean isClosed, daysRemaining, isUrgent (<= 7 days), and human-readable status badge key
Rejects invalid formats gracefully with safe fallback semantics
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/deadline-semantics.test.ts && npm run typecheck

milestone-6-extraction-deadlines-anonymi.description: Implement operator-assisted reviewer account anonymization service to enable GDPR/privacy deletion compliance for administrator and reviewer accounts with existing catalogue edits, source creations, or audit trail records without compromising audit history integrity.
acceptance_criteria: anonymizeReviewerContributions(sql, operatorId, targetUserId, reason) safely decouples reviewer personal identity from published audit history
Verifies operator authority (enforces admin privilege for the acting operator)

Reassigns all reviewer contributions (sources.created_by, opportunity_revisions.actor_id, source_collection_policies.actor_id, research_job_actions.actor_id) to a deterministic redacted pseudonym (anonymized-reviewer-<hash>)
Records an immutable administrative audit action in the database documenting the anonymization event with timestamp and justification
After anonymization, unblocks requestAccountDeletion for the targeted user so their account, sessions, and personal profile can be purged
Operates transactionally to prevent partial or corrupted anonymization state
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/operator-anonymization.test.ts && npm run typecheck
